info.name: Wikipedia - Hacker Green | Dark
info.description:
Enable dark mode on the Wikipedia website for better integration. 

Wikipedia in the colors of ChatGPT Hacker Green. The original
charcoal canvas, pale green 40-pixel grid and subtle 4-pixel scanlines
sit behind emerald glass panels, terminal type, and a glowing puzzle
globe. Search, language controls, menus, scrollbars and keyboard focus
share the same green palette.
